ana (AE): Heads-up: PrismRyx sent an RFI asking for POC acceptance criteria, reserved capacity pricing bands, overage rates, KMS compatibility, and a short preflight checklist for infra. Can we pull answers together?
ben (SE): I9ll take the POC runbook. They want 160 qps gen and 800 rpm embedding. Suggest a 10-business-day pilot: embed p95 < 350ms, gen end-to-end p95 < 650ms, error rate < 0.5%.
carlos (Solutions Eng): For 160 qps sustained recommend Dedicated with 1.5x headroom. Pricing ballpark: $13k-$21k/month depending on region & term. Propose a 20% pilot discount off low-end for 30-day trials. Overage: $0.12 per gen-token-equivalent, $0.001 per embed.
dina (Security Eng): KMS/HSM copy for the RFI: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys (BYOK) for Dedicated and Private via KMIP-compatible HSMs and major cloud KMS providers. Hosted API supports envelope BYOK integrations. Key usage audit events and exportable logs available." Also: "SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 reports available under NDA; annual third-party pentests."
ana (AE): Small note: they asked explicitly whether pilot data can be restricted to EU only and whether we can scrub caches at pilot end.
dina (Security Eng): Yes to both. Copyable line: "Pilot workloads can be region-restricted (EU-only). Temporary caches are scrubbed at pilot termination; KV cache TTL configurable and default = 0 for ephemeral handling."
ben (SE): Preflight checklist for their infra ops: 
- Allow outbound 443 to eu.api.redwood.ai and dedicated-region endpoints
- Optionally whitelist egress IPs
- Run healthcheck: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/health
- TLS verify: openssl s_client -connect eu.api.redwood.ai:443 -brief
ana (AE): Contracts asked about refundable deposit practice. Standard is one-month reserved fee held and refundable if pilot acceptance met. I9ll capture that in the commercial sheet on Drive.
contracts-bot: DPA and SOW templates uploaded to shared Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/prismryx-rfi/
carlos (Solutions Eng): I9ll update the capability matrix with one-line rows for Data Residency, KMS/HSM, Observability, Rollout & Failover, and Quantization support.
nana (AE): Action items recap: ben = runbook + preflight; carlos = pricing bands + capmatrix edits; dina = security copy + DPA notes; I9ll assemble and loop in Legal. Thanks all :thumbsup: I9ll post compiled RFI here when ready.
